title: Elev8 Hand Crafted Duff Jar
description:
Elev8 Duff Jar
These Duff Jars have all been hand crafted by the good folks over at Elev8 Glass. Each piece is made from very heavy gauge glass and no two Duff Jars are the same. They all have their basic shape but for the most part they let the glass settle into its own unique shape.
These Duff Jars are designed to be used with wands from the 7th floor range of vaporizer like the Silver Surfer, Da Buddha and Super Surfer Vaporizer. Spent herb (ABV) is blown in through the opening at the top.
Included
1 x Elev8 Duff Jar
